correctness.rationale: For µ_w=(1-w)σ+wδ_N on S² with 0<w<1, the centered moment inverse gives K_w(x,y)=1+3(x1y1+x2y2)/(1-w)+3(x3-w)(y3-w)/[(1-w)(1+3w)]. For r=w/(1+3w), t=1+3 x·N, direct integration yields F_r(t)=(9q_r(t)+u_r(t)^2)/(6√q_r(t))+r|t| with q=1+2rt/3-r(2/3-r)t², u=1-rt. A derivative zero lies among real roots of a sextic P²-144r²q³, and endpoints/cusp t∈{-2,0,4} exhaust maxima. Symbolic independent checks reproduce derivative, exact sextic leading term, local antipodal derivative threshold r=1/6 (w=1/3), F(0)=5/3, and 30 independent numerical uniform-sphere kernel row integrals. Limit comparison F_(1/4) uniquely normed at t=-2 and strict off-antipodal dominance at w=1/3 plus continuity prove at least one separate global coexistence transition. Neither finite integrations nor polynomial examples replace the analytic positivity/factorization and compactness proof.
